a:r.a:t: BursaIQ presents one governed AI workforce powered by two complementary model paths.
Microsoft providers support connected enterprise experiences; self-hosted models provide local control and choice.
Select Microsoft or local open-source AI according to the work, policy and operating context.
Users work with specialist agents without managing separate tools or model interfaces.
Answers and deliverables remain grounded in approved knowledge and traceable sources.
People review important outputs before the organisation publishes or reuses them.
Proposed architecture: a shared BursaIQ governance layer across Microsoft AI services and self-hosted
, with one experience for users and reviewers.
